Meal Name: Jamaican Ackee & Scrambled Eggs
Ingredients:
• 1 cup canned ackee, drained
• 2 eggs
• 1/4 bell pepper, diced
• 1 scallion, chopped
• 1 tsp olive oil
• Pinch of black pepper
Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in pan
2. Sauté bell pepper and scallion 2 min
3. Gently fold in the drained canned ackee and heat through for 2–3 min
4. Push to the side and scramble the eggs until firm
5. Mix together, season with pepper
Safety Notes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy, so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

Meal Name: Callaloo, Black Bean & Sweet Potato Hash
Ingredients:
• 2 cups callaloo, chopped
• 1/2 cup cooked black beans, rinsed and drained
• 1/2 small sweet potato, diced
• 1/4 onion, diced
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds
• 1 tsp olive oil
• 1/4 tsp thyme
Instructions:
1. Steam diced sweet potato 8–10 min until fork-tender
2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté onion and garlic for 2 min
3. Add callaloo and black beans, cooking 4–5 min until greens are tender
4. Fold in sweet potato, season with thyme, and top with pumpkin seeds

Meal Name: Spiced Almond Chia & Berry Pudding
Ingredients:
• 1/4 cup chia seeds
• 3/4 cup unsweetened almond milk
• 1/4 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1/3 cup fresh mixed berries
• 1 tbsp chopped walnuts
• 1 tsp vanilla extract
• Pinch of nutmeg and cinnamon
Instructions:
1. Whisk chia seeds with unsweetened almond milk, vanilla, nutmeg and cinnamon
2. Refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight until thick
3. Stir in plain Greek yogurt before serving
4. Top with fresh berries and chopped walnuts

Meal Name: Jerk Spiced Tofu Scramble
Ingredients:
• 1 block firm tofu, crumbled
• 1 tsp jerk seasoning
• 1/4 bell pepper, diced
• 2 mushrooms, sliced
• 1 tsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp nutritional yeast
Instructions:
1. Press tofu to remove excess water
2. Heat oil, sauté vegetables
3. Add tofu and jerk seasoning
4. Cook 8-10 min until golden
5. Stir in nutritional yeast

Meal Name: Green Banana, Flax & Walnut Porridge
Ingredients:
• 1 small green banana, grated
• 1 cup unsweetened soy or almond milk
• 2 tbsp hemp seeds
• 1 tbsp ground flaxseed
• 1 tbsp chopped walnuts
• 1/2 tsp cinnamon
• 1 tsp vanilla extract
• Pinch of salt
Instructions:
1. Finely grate the green banana
2. Bring milk to a gentle simmer in a small pot
3. Whisk in grated green banana and cook 8–10 min, stirring constantly
4. Stir in cinnamon, vanilla, ground flaxseed and hemp seeds until thickened
5. Top with chopped walnuts and serve warm

Meal Name: Protein Pumpkin & Almond Pancakes
Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup pumpkin puree
• 2 eggs
• 1/4 cup almond flour
• 1 tbsp ground flaxseed
• 1 tsp baking powder
• 1/2 tsp cinnamon
• 1 tsp olive oil
Instructions:
1. Whisk pumpkin puree, eggs, almond flour, flaxseed, baking powder and cinnamon in a bowl
2. Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat
3. Pour batter and cook about 3 min per side until golden and set in the centre
4. Serve warm

Meal Name: Jamaican Ackee, Green Banana & Black Bean Bowl
Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup canned ackee, drained
• 1/2 cup cooked black beans, rinsed
• 1 small green banana, boiled and sliced
• 1 cup steamed spinach or cabbage
• 1/4 avocado, sliced
• 1 tsp olive oil
• Pinch of black pepper
Instructions:
1. Boil green banana until tender and steam the greens for 3 min
2. Gently heat the drained canned ackee and black beans in a pan for 2–3 min
3. Arrange on a plate with sliced avocado and greens
4. Drizzle with olive oil and season with black pepper
Safety Notes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy, so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

Meal Name: Avocado & Saltfish on Whole-Grain Toast
Ingredients:
• 1 slice whole grain bread
• 1/4 avocado, mashed
• 1/4 cup saltfish, soaked overnight (or boiled 15–20 min), rinsed and flaked
• 1 tsp lime juice
• 1 tomato slice
• Black pepper
Instructions:
1. After desalting according to the product instructions, cook the saltfish until a food thermometer reads 145°F (63°C) in the thickest part; then flake it.
2. Toast bread
3. Mix avocado with lime juice
4. Spread on toast
5. Top with the flaked saltfish and tomato
6. Season with pepper

Meal Name: Greek Yogurt, Papaya & Walnut Parfait
Ingredients:
• 3/4 cup plain Greek yogurt
• 1/4 cup papaya cubes
• 1/4 cup fresh berries
• 2 tbsp chopped walnuts or almonds
• 1 tbsp chia seeds
• 1/4 tsp cinnamon
Instructions:
1. Layer plain Greek yogurt, papaya cubes and berries in a bowl or glass
2. Top with chopped nuts and chia seeds
3. Dust lightly with cinnamon and serve

Meal Name: Jamaican Spiced Oat & Flax Porridge
Ingredients:
• 1/3 cup rolled oats
• 1 cup unsweetened soy or almond milk
• 1 tbsp ground flaxseed
• 1 tbsp chia seeds
• 1 tbsp chopped almonds
• 1 cinnamon stick
• 1/4 tsp nutmeg
• 1 tsp vanilla extract
Instructions:
1. Combine rolled oats, milk and cinnamon stick in a small pot
2. Bring to a gentle boil, then simmer 8–10 min, stirring occasionally
3. Remove cinnamon stick and stir in flaxseed, chia seeds, nutmeg and vanilla
4. Top with chopped almonds and serve warm

Meal Name: Ackee & Saltfish Salad
Ingredients:
• 1 cup canned ackee, drained
• ½ cup saltfish (soaked overnight, flaked)
• 2 cups mixed greens
• ¼ avocado, sliced
• ½ cucumber, diced
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• Black pepper to taste
• 1 scallion, chopped
Instructions:
1. Drain the canned ackee gently so it keeps its shape.
2. Desalt the saltfish according to the product instructions, then cook until a food thermometer in the thickest part reads 145°F (63°C). Rinse as directed and flake; soaking alone does not cook fish.
3. In a bowl, combine greens, cucumber, avocado.
4. Heat olive oil in pan, sauté garlic 30 sec, add ackee and saltfish, warm through (2-3 min).
5. Place ackee-saltfish mix over greens.
6. Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, pepper for dressing, drizzle.
7. Garnish with scallion.
Safety Notes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy, so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

Meal Name: Chicken & Callaloo Egg Muffins
Ingredients:
• 2 eggs
• ½ cup cooked chicken, shredded (cooked to 165°F / 74°C)
• 1 cup callaloo (or spinach), chopped
• ¼ bell pepper, diced
• 1 scallion, chopped
• 2 tbsp unsweetened almond milk
• ¼ tsp turmeric
• Pinch of black pepper
• Olive oil spray
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. Whisk eggs with unsweetened almond milk, turmeric, pepper.
3. Stir in chicken, callaloo, bell pepper, scallion.
4. Spray muffin tin with olive oil.
5. Pour mixture into 6 muffin cups.
6. Bake 18–20 min until set and a thermometer in the centre reads 165°F (74°C).
7. Cool 5 min before removing.

Meal Name: Sardine & Vegetable Skillet
Ingredients:
• 1 can sardines in olive oil
• 1 cup mixed vegetables (zucchini, bell pepper, onion)
• 1 tsp Jamaican seasoning
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp lime juice
• ½ tsp thyme
• Black pepper
Instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in large skillet.
2. Sauté garlic and vegetables 5-7 min until tender.
3. Add sardines with their oil, break into chunks.
4. Season with Jamaican seasoning, thyme, pepper.
5. Cook 3-4 min until heated through.
6. Drizzle with lime juice before serving.

Meal Name: Jerk Chicken & Cabbage Stir-fry
Ingredients:
• 1 chicken breast, sliced
• 2 cups cabbage, shredded
• 1 carrot, julienned
• 1 tbsp jerk seasoning
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tsp ginger, grated
• 2 tbsp water
Instructions:
1. Season chicken with jerk seasoning.
2. Heat oil in wok or large pan.
3. Stir-fry chicken 5–6 min until no longer pink and it reaches 165°F (74°C).
4. Remove chicken, add more oil if needed.
5. Stir-fry cabbage and carrot 3-4 min.
6. Return chicken to pan, add water, cook 2 min.
7. Serve hot.
Safety Notes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

Meal Name: Ackee & Tofu Scramble
Ingredients:
• 1 cup canned ackee, drained
• ½ block firm tofu
• ¼ onion, diced
• 1 tomato, diced
• 1 tsp turmeric
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp thyme
• Black pepper
Instructions:
1. Press tofu to remove excess water, crumble.
2. Heat oil, sauté onion until translucent.
3. Add tomato, cook 2 min.
4. Add ackee and tofu, gently stir.
5. Season with turmeric, thyme, pepper.
6. Cook 5-7 min until heated through.
Safety Notes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy, so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

Meal Name: Callaloo & Egg White Frittata
Ingredients:
• 4 egg whites
• 1 cup callaloo, chopped
• ¼ bell pepper, diced
• 1 tbsp nutritional yeast
• 1 tsp olive oil
• Pinch of black pepper
• 1 garlic clove, minced
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Sauté callaloo, bell pepper, garlic in oil 3 min.
3. Whisk egg whites with nutritional yeast, pepper.
4. Pour over vegetables in oven-safe dish.
5. Bake 12–15 min until set and the centre reads 160°F (71°C).
6. Let cool 5 min before slicing.

Meal Name: Protein Power Bowl: Beans & Greens
Ingredients:
• ½ cup black beans, cooked
• 2 cups mixed greens
• ¼ avocado, diced
• ¼ cup corn kernels
• 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp lime juice
• ½ tsp cumin
Instructions:
1. Arrange greens in bowl.
2. Top with beans, corn, avocado.
3. Sprinkle pumpkin seeds.
4. Whisk olive oil, lime juice, cumin for dressing.
5. Drizzle over bowl.

Meal Name: Green Protein & Berry Smoothie Bowl
Ingredients:
• 1 cup spinach
• ¼ avocado, diced
• ½ cup plain Greek yogurt
• ½ cup unsweetened almond milk
• 1 scoop protein powder
• 1 tbsp chia seeds
• 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds
• ½ cup mixed berries
Instructions:
1. Blend spinach, avocado, Greek yogurt, almond milk and protein powder until thick and smooth.
2. Pour into a bowl.
3. Top with mixed berries, chia seeds and pumpkin seeds.
4. Enjoy immediately.

Meal Name: Jamaican Chicken Salad Wrap
Ingredients:
• 1 whole grain tortilla
• ½ cup cooked chicken, shredded (cooked to 165°F / 74°C and chilled)
• 1 cup mixed greens
• ¼ avocado, sliced
• 2 tbsp Greek yogurt
• 1 tsp jerk seasoning
• 1 tsp lime juice
Instructions:
1. Mix chicken with jerk seasoning and lime juice.
2. Warm tortilla if desired.
3. Spread Greek yogurt on tortilla.
4. Layer greens, chicken, avocado.
5. Roll tightly and slice.

Meal Name: Pumpkin & Red Lentil Soup
Ingredients:
• 2 cups pumpkin, cubed
• ½ cup red lentils
• 1 carrot, diced
• 1 celery stalk, diced
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 cups vegetable broth
• 1 tsp thyme
• 1 tsp turmeric
Instructions:
1. Sauté onion, carrot, celery in pot 5 min.
2. Add pumpkin, lentils, broth, and spices.
3. Bring to boil, then simmer 20-25 min.
4. Blend partially for creamier texture.
5. Season to taste.

Meal Name: Steamed Fish with Okra & Pumpkin
Ingredients:
• 1 snapper fillet (about 6 oz / 170 g)
• 6 okras, sliced
• 1 cup pumpkin, cubed
• 2 scallions
• Thyme, scotch bonnet
• Salt, black pepper
Instructions:
1. Season fish with salt and thyme
2. Place in pot with okra and pumpkin
3. Add scallion and scotch bonnet
4. Steam over medium heat 15–20 min until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads 145°F (63°C)

Meal Name: Jerk Chicken over Spinach Salad
Ingredients:
• 1 chicken breast
• 2 tbsp jerk seasoning
• 3 cups spinach
• 1/2 avocado
• Cherry tomatoes
• Lime juice and olive oil
Instructions:
1. Coat chicken with jerk seasoning
2. Grill or pan-fry about 6 min per side until it reaches 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part
3. Slice and place over spinach
4. Add avocado and tomatoes
5. Dress with lime juice and olive oil
Safety Notes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

Meal Name: Curried Chickpea & Callaloo
Ingredients:
• 1 can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
• 2 cups callaloo
• 1 tbsp curry powder
• 1/4 onion
• 1 garlic clove
• 1 tsp olive oil
Instructions:
1. Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil
2. Add curry powder, toast 1 min
3. Add chickpeas, coat well
4. Add callaloo, cook 5 min
5. Season and serve

Meal Name: Jamaican Salmon with Pumpkin & Greens
Ingredients:
• 1 salmon fillet (150-200g)
• ½ cup pumpkin, cubed
• 1 cup bok choy or callaloo
• ½ cup green beans
• 1 tsp olive oil
• 1 tsp Jamaican jerk seasoning (low-sodium)
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• ½ tsp thyme
• ½ lemon wedge
• Pinch of black pepper
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Rub salmon with jerk seasoning, thyme, black pepper.
3. Place salmon on a baking sheet and bake 12–15 min until it flakes easily and reaches 145°F (63°C).
4. Steam pumpkin cubes 10-12 min until tender.
5. Heat olive oil in pan, sauté garlic 30 sec, add bok choy and green beans, cook 4-5 min until vibrant.
6. Plate salmon with pumpkin and greens.
7. Squeeze lemon over everything.

Meal Name: Tuna & Avocado Stuffed Sweet Potato
Ingredients:
• 1 medium sweet potato
• 1 can tuna in water, drained
• ¼ avocado, mashed
• 1 tbsp Greek yogurt
• 1 tsp lime juice
• ½ tsp paprika
• 1 scallion, chopped
• Black pepper
Instructions:
1. Bake sweet potato at 400°F (200°C) for 45–50 min until tender.
2. Let cool slightly, then slice open.
3. Mix tuna with avocado, Greek yogurt, lime juice, paprika.
4. Stuff sweet potato with tuna mixture.
5. Garnish with scallion and pepper.

Meal Name: Jamaican Curry Chicken with Steamed Cabbage
Ingredients:
• 2 skinless chicken breasts, cubed
• 2 cups cabbage, shredded
• 1/2 bell pepper, sliced
• 1 tbsp Jamaican curry powder
• 1 onion, diced
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tsp fresh ginger, grated
• 1 tsp thyme
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1/2 cup water
Instructions:
1. Season cubed chicken with curry powder, thyme, garlic and ginger.
2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and brown the chicken with onion for 4–5 min.
3. Add water, cover and simmer 10–12 min until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
4. Stir in shredded cabbage and sliced bell pepper and steam 4–5 min until tender-crisp.
5. Serve hot.
Safety Notes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

Meal Name: Curry Goat with Cauliflower Rice
Ingredients:
• 1 lb goat meat, trimmed
• 2 tbsp curry powder
• 1 onion, sliced
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tsp ginger, grated
• 1 cup cauliflower rice
• 1 cup water
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp thyme
Instructions:
1. Marinate goat meat with curry powder 30 min.
2. Heat oil, brown meat on all sides.
3. Add onion, garlic, ginger, sauté 5 min.
4. Add water and simmer 1.5–2 hours until the meat is very tender and a food thermometer in the thickest part reads at least 160°F (71°C).
5. Let the meat rest for at least 3 minutes before serving.
6. Serve over cauliflower rice.

Meal Name: Steamed Fish with Cho-Cho & Carrots
Ingredients:
• 2 fish fillets (snapper or mahi mahi)
• 1 cho-cho, sliced
• 1 carrot, sliced
• 1 bell pepper, sliced
• 1 tsp olive oil
• 1 tsp Jamaican seasoning
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• ½ cup water
• 1 tsp thyme
Instructions:
1. Season fish with Jamaican seasoning.
2. Arrange vegetables in steamer basket.
3. Place fish on top.
4. Steam 15–20 min until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads 145°F (63°C).
5. Drizzle with olive oil before serving.

Meal Name: Oven-Roasted Chicken with Root Vegetables
Ingredients:
• 2 chicken thighs, skinless
• 1 sweet potato, cubed
• 1 carrot, sliced
• 1 onion, quartered
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tbsp jerk seasoning
• 1 tsp rosemary
• Black pepper
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Toss vegetables with oil and seasoning.
3. Arrange chicken and vegetables on baking sheet.
4. Roast 35–40 min until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.
5. Serve hot.
Safety Notes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

Meal Name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Ground Turkey
Ingredients:
• 2 bell peppers, halved
• ½ lb ground turkey
• ½ cup cauliflower rice
• ¼ onion, diced
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tsp Jamaican seasoning
• ½ cup tomato sauce
• 1 tbsp olive oil
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
2. Sauté turkey, onion and garlic until no pink remains and the turkey reaches 165°F (74°C).
3. Mix with cauliflower rice and tomato sauce.
4. Stuff bell pepper halves.
5. Bake 25-30 min until peppers are tender.
Safety Notes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

Meal Name: Jerk Pork with Roasted Vegetables
Ingredients:
• 1 lb (450 g) pork loin, trimmed
• 2 tbsp jerk marinade
• 2 cups mixed vegetables (carrots, zucchini, onion)
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp thyme
• 1 garlic clove, minced
Instructions:
1. Marinate pork in jerk marinade 1 hour.
2. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
3. Roast pork 25–30 min until it reaches 145°F (63°C) in the centre.
4. Toss vegetables with oil and thyme, roast alongside.
5. Rest pork at least 3 min before slicing.

Meal Name: Callaloo & Saltfish Patties
Ingredients:
• 2 cups callaloo, chopped
• ½ cup saltfish, soaked overnight (or boiled 15–20 min), rinsed and flaked
• 1 egg
• 2 tbsp almond flour
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp thyme
• Black pepper
• 1 scallion, chopped
Instructions:
1. Steam callaloo until wilted, squeeze out excess water.
2. Mix with saltfish, egg, almond flour, thyme, scallion.
3. Form into patties.
4. Heat oil and cook patties 3–4 min per side until golden and firm in the centre (160°F / 71°C).
5. Drain on paper towels.

Meal Name: Jamaican Oxtail Stew (Lean)
Ingredients:
• 1 lb oxtail, trimmed of fat
• 1 onion, chopped
• 2 carrots, chopped
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 2 cups beef broth (low-sodium)
• 1 tbsp browning sauce
• 1 tsp thyme
• 2 pimento berries
• 1 scotch bonnet pepper (whole)
Instructions:
1. Brown oxtail in pot.
2. Add onion, carrots, garlic, sauté 5 min.
3. Add broth, browning sauce, thyme, pimento, scotch bonnet.
4. Simmer 2.5–3 hours until the meat is very tender and a food thermometer in the thickest part reads at least 160°F (71°C).
5. Let the meat rest for at least 3 minutes before serving.
6. Remove scotch bonnet before serving.

Meal Name: Grilled Snapper with Steamed Veg
Ingredients:
• 1 snapper fillet
• Broccoli florets
• Sliced carrots
• Lemon juice
• Olive oil, garlic
• Fresh thyme
Instructions:
1. Marinate fillet in lemon, garlic and thyme
2. Grill about 5 min per side until opaque and it reaches 145°F (63°C)
3. Steam broccoli and carrots 8 min
4. Plate with a drizzle of olive oil

Meal Name: Jamaican Brown Stew Tofu
Ingredients:
• 1 block firm tofu, cubed
• 1 cup broccoli florets
• 1/2 bell pepper, sliced
• 1 carrot, sliced
• 1 tbsp browning
• 1 onion, sliced
• 2 garlic cloves
• Pimento berries, thyme
• 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
Instructions:
1. Press and cube tofu, pat dry
2. Brown in oil until golden
3. Add onion, garlic, bell pepper, carrot and pimento
4. Stir in browning and low-sodium soy sauce
5. Add broccoli and simmer in 1/4 cup water 8–10 min until vegetables are tender-crisp

Meal Name: Herb-Crusted Turkey Breast
Ingredients:
• 1 boneless turkey breast (about 1 lb / 450 g)
• 2 cups green beans, trimmed
• Fresh rosemary and thyme
• 3 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tbsp olive oil
• 1 lemon wedge
• Salt and black pepper
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C)
2. Mix herbs, garlic and oil into a paste
3. Rub all over the turkey breast
4. Roast until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C), about 30–40 min for a 1 lb breast (longer for larger cuts), steaming the green beans for the last 6–8 min
5. Rest 5 min before slicing and serve with steamed green beans and lemon
Safety Notes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

Meal Name: Mediterranean Shakshuka with Chickpeas
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
• 1 cup crushed tomatoes (no sugar added)
• 1 cup baby spinach
• 1/4 red bell pepper, diced
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1/2 tsp ground cumin and paprika
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the bell pepper and garlic for 3 minutes.
2. Stir in the cumin, paprika, crushed tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
3. Wilted in the baby spinach, make two wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
4. Cover and cook for 5-6 minutes until the egg whites and yolks are firm, then serve.
Safety Notes: Cook eggs until whites and yolks are firm (or reach 160°F / 71°C for egg dishes).

Meal Name: Mexican Huevos Rancheros Black Bean Bowl
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 1/2 cup cooked black beans, rinsed and drained
• 1 cup chopped romaine or baby spinach
• 1/2 cup fresh pico de gallo (tomato, onion, cilantro, lime)
• 1/4 avocado, sliced
• 1/2 tsp ground cumin
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Warm the black beans with cumin in a small pan over medium-low heat for 3-4 minutes.
2. Heat the avocado oil in a skillet and scramble or fry the eggs until the whites and yolks are firm.
3. Layer the greens and warm black beans in a bowl, top with the eggs, pico de gallo and sliced avocado.

Meal Name: Japanese Tamagoyaki & Miso Tofu Greens
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs, beaten
• 100g firm tofu, cubed
• 2 cups baby spinach and bok choy
• 1 tsp white miso paste dissolved in 2 tbsp warm water
• 1 scallion, finely sliced
• 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
• 1 tsp sesame seeds
Instructions:
1. Brush a pan with half the sesame oil over medium heat, pour in the beaten eggs in thin layers and roll into a firm omelet.
2. In the same pan, warm the remaining sesame oil and sear the tofu cubes for 3 minutes.
3. Toss in the spinach, bok choy and dissolved miso water; cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
4. Slice the egg roll and serve alongside the miso tofu greens topped with scallion and sesame seeds.

Meal Name: Middle Eastern Za'atar Eggs & Tahini Greens
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 2 cups chopped kale or baby spinach
• 1/2 cucumber, diced
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 1 tbsp tahini mixed with 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tbsp water
• 1 tsp za'atar seasoning
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the kale for 3-4 minutes until tender.
2. Crack the eggs into the skillet, sprinkle with za'atar, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until firm.
3. Arrange the cucumber and cherry tomatoes in a bowl with the cooked kale and eggs, then drizzle with the lemon-tahini dressing.

Meal Name: Indian Savory Chickpea & Spinach Cheela
Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup chickpea flour (besan)
• 2 tbsp hemp hearts
• 1 cup finely chopped baby spinach
• 1/4 red onion, finely diced
• 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
• 1/2 tsp ground turmeric and cumin
• 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Whisk the chickpea flour, hemp hearts, turmeric, cumin and 1/2 cup water into a smooth batter.
2. Fold the chopped spinach, red onion, ginger and cilantro into the batter.
3. Heat the avocado oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat, pour in the batter to form two thin crepes and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

Meal Name: Nordic Seared Salmon & Avocado Breakfast Plate
Ingredients:
• 1 salmon fillet (about 140g)
• 2 cups baby arugula and spinach
• 1/4 avocado, sliced
• 1/2 cucumber, sliced into ribbons
• 1 tsp capers, drained
• 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Season the salmon fillet with black pepper and lemon juice.
2. Sear the salmon in a hot skillet with olive oil for 3-4 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the salmon reads 145°F (63°C).
3. Plate the salmon over the arugula, cucumber ribbons, sliced avocado and capers.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Herb Turkey & Mushroom Breakfast Skillet
Ingredients:
• 140g lean ground turkey
• 1 cup cremini mushrooms, sliced
• 2 cups baby spinach
• 1/4 bell pepper, diced
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1/2 tsp dried thyme and rosemary
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground turkey with thyme and rosemary for 6-7 minutes.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reaches 165°F (74°C).
3. Add the mushrooms, bell pepper and garlic; sauté for 4 minutes until tender.
4. Fold in the baby spinach until wilted and serve warm.
Safety Notes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: North African Harissa Chickpea & Egg Skillet
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
• 1 small zucchini, diced
• 1/2 cup diced tomatoes
• 1 cup chopped kale
• 1 tsp mild harissa paste
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the zucchini and kale for 4 minutes.
2. Stir in the chickpeas, diced tomatoes and harissa paste; simmer for 3 minutes.
3. Crack the two eggs on top, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites and yolks are firm.

Meal Name: Greek Lemon-Oregano Chicken & Quinoa Bowl
Ingredients:
• 150g skinless chicken breast
• 1/3 cup cooked quinoa
• 2 cups chopped romaine and arugula
• 1/2 cucumber, diced
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 6 kalamata olives, pitted and halved
• 1 tsp dried oregano and 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Rub the chicken breast with oregano, half the lemon juice, half the olive oil and black pepper.
2. Grill or pan-sear over medium heat for 6-7 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
3. Arrange the greens, cooked quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes and olives in a bowl, top with sliced chicken and drizzle with remaining lemon juice and olive oil.
Safety Notes: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Japanese Seared Salmon & Edamame Bowl
Ingredients:
• 150g salmon fillet, cubed
• 1/2 cup shelled edamame, steamed
• 2 cups shredded purple and green cabbage
• 1/2 cucumber, sliced
• 1/4 avocado, diced
• 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 tsp rice vinegar
• 1 tsp toasted sesame oil and 1 tsp sesame seeds
Instructions:
1. Sear the salmon cubes in a skillet over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece reads 145°F (63°C).
2. Arrange the shredded cabbage, steamed edamame, cucumber and avocado in a bowl.
3. Top with the warm seared salmon, drizzle with soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame oil, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Safety Notes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Mexican Chicken Tinga Lettuce Wraps
Ingredients:
• 150g skinless chicken breast
• 1/3 cup cooked black beans, rinsed
• 4 large romaine lettuce leaves
• 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes with 1/2 tsp smoked paprika and cumin
• 1/4 onion and 1 garlic clove, sliced
• 1/4 avocado, sliced
• 2 tbsp fresh cilantro and 1 lime wedge
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Sauté the onion and garlic in avocado oil over medium heat for 2 minutes, then add the chicken breast, crushed tomatoes, paprika and cumin.
2. Cover and simmer for 14-16 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
3. Shred the chicken into the smoky tomato sauce, spoon into crisp romaine leaves with black beans, and top with avocado, cilantro and lime.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Indian Tandoori Chicken & Kachumber Salad
Ingredients:
• 150g skinless chicken breast
• 2 tbsp plain unsweetened Greek yogurt
• 1 tsp garam masala, cumin and turmeric
• 1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 2 cups baby spinach
• 1/2 cucumber and 1 roma tomato, diced
• 1/4 red onion, thinly sliced
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and fresh mint
Instructions:
1. Coat the chicken breast in the Greek yogurt, ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin and turmeric.
2. Roast or pan-sear over medium heat for 6-8 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
3. Toss the spinach, cucumber, tomato, red onion and mint with lemon juice, and top with the sliced tandoori chicken.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Lebanese Chicken Shawarma & Tahini Salad Bowl
Ingredients:
• 150g skinless chicken breast, sliced into strips
• 1/3 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed
• 2 cups chopped romaine lettuce and parsley
• 1/2 cucumber and 2 radishes, sliced
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 1 tsp ground cumin, coriander, paprika and cinnamon
• 1 tbsp tahini whisked with 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Toss the chicken strips with the cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon and olive oil.
2. Sear in a hot skillet over medium-high heat for 7-8 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest strip of chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
3. Assemble the romaine, parsley, chickpeas, cucumber, radishes and tomatoes in a bowl, top with the warm chicken and drizzle with lemon-tahini dressing.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Thai Basil Tofu & Green Bean Stir-Fry
Ingredients:
• 150g extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed
• 1.5 cups fresh green beans, trimmed
• 1/2 red bell pepper, sliced
• 1 cup riced cauliflower
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 tsp lime juice
• 1/2 cup fresh Thai basil leaves
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the avocado oil in a wok or skillet over medium-high heat and sear the tofu cubes for 5-6 minutes until golden.
2. Add the green beans, bell pepper and garlic; stir-fry for 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
3. Stir in the riced cauliflower, soy sauce and lime juice for 2 minutes, then fold in the fresh Thai basil and serve.

Meal Name: Mediterranean Canned Tuna & White Bean Salad
Ingredients:
• 1 can tuna in water (about 140g), drained
• 1/2 cup cooked cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
• 2 cups baby arugula and spinach
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 1/4 red onion, thinly sliced
• 1 tsp capers and 1 tbsp chopped parsley
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Place the arugula, spinach, cherry tomatoes, red onion and cannellini beans in a large bowl.
2. Flake the drained canned tuna over the salad and add the capers and parsley.
3. Drizzle with the lemon juice and extra-virgin olive oil, toss gently and serve.

Meal Name: West African Chickpea & Spinach Groundnut Stew
Ingredients:
• 3/4 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
• 2 cups baby spinach, chopped
• 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes
• 1 tbsp natural unsweetened peanut butter
• 1/4 onion, diced
• 1 garlic clove and 1 tsp fresh ginger, grated
• 1/2 cup low-sodium vegetable broth
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Warm the avocado oil in a pot over medium heat and sauté the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
2. Whisk in the crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth and natural peanut butter until smooth.
3. Add the chickpeas and simmer for 8-10 minutes until rich and fragrant.
4. Fold in the chopped spinach for 2 minutes until wilted and serve warm.

Meal Name: Mediterranean Baked Cod with Tomatoes & Olives
Ingredients:
• 1 cod fillet (about 170g)
• 1 medium zucchini, sliced into half-moons
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 6 kalamata olives, pitted
• 1 tsp capers, drained
• 1 garlic clove, sliced
• 1 tsp dried oregano and 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
2. Arrange the zucchini, cherry tomatoes, olives, capers and garlic in a baking dish, and place the cod fillet on top.
3. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, and season with oregano and black pepper.
4. Bake for 14-16 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the cod reads 145°F (63°C).
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Korean Ginger-Soy Salmon with Bok Choy
Ingredients:
• 1 salmon fillet (about 160g)
• 2 heads baby bok choy, halved
• 1 cup shiitake or cremini mushrooms, sliced
• 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
• 1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
• 1 scallion, sliced, and 1 tsp sesame seeds
Instructions:
1. Whisk together the soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil.
2. Sear the salmon fillet in a non-stick skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes per side, brushing with half the ginger-soy glaze.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the salmon reads 145°F (63°C).
4. In the same skillet, sauté the mushrooms and bok choy with the remaining glaze for 4 minutes until tender-crisp, then plate with the salmon.
Safety Notes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Mexican Lime-Cilantro Fish Fajita Bowl
Ingredients:
• 1 tilapia or snapper fillet (about 160g)
• 1 cup riced cauliflower
• 1/3 cup cooked black beans, rinsed
• 1/2 green and 1/2 red bell pepper, sliced
• 1/4 onion, sliced
• 1/4 avocado, sliced
• 1 tsp ground cumin and chili powder
• 1 tbsp lime juice, fresh cilantro and 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Rub the fish fillet with cumin, chili powder and half the lime juice.
2. Sauté the bell peppers and onion in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes, then push to the side and add the fish fillet.
3. Cook the fish for 3-4 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads 145°F (63°C).
4. Warm the riced cauliflower and black beans, top with the fish and peppers, and garnish with avocado, cilantro and lime.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Indian Chana Palak (Spinach & Chickpea Masala)
Ingredients:
• 3/4 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
• 3 cups fresh baby spinach
• 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes
• 2 tbsp pumpkin seeds or hemp hearts
• 1/4 onion, finely diced
• 1 garlic clove and 1 tsp fresh ginger, minced
• 1 tsp garam masala, ground cumin and turmeric
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the avocado oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the onion, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
2. Add the garam masala, cumin, turmeric and crushed tomatoes; simmer for 4 minutes.
3. Stir in the chickpeas and baby spinach, cooking for 6-8 minutes until the spinach is tender and coated in the spiced tomato gravy.
4. Top with pumpkin seeds or hemp hearts and serve warm.

Meal Name: Middle Eastern Turkey Kofta & Roasted Eggplant
Ingredients:
• 160g lean ground turkey
• 1.5 cups cubed eggplant
• 1 cup chopped cucumber and tomato salad
• 2 tbsp finely chopped fresh parsley and mint
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tsp ground cumin, coriander and cinnamon
• 1 tbsp tahini mixed with 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the cubed eggplant with olive oil and roast on a baking sheet for 20 minutes until golden.
2. Mix the ground turkey with the garlic, parsley, cumin, coriander and cinnamon, and shape into 3 oval koftas.
3. Bake or pan-sear the turkey koftas for 12-14 minutes until a food thermometer in the centre of the turkey reads 165°F (74°C).
4. Serve the turkey koftas with the roasted eggplant, cucumber-tomato salad and lemon-tahini drizzle.
Safety Notes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Moroccan Lemon & Olive Chicken Tagine
Ingredients:
• 160g skinless chicken breast, cubed
• 1 medium zucchini, cubed
• 1/2 carrot, sliced
• 6 green olives, pitted and halved
• 1/4 onion and 1 garlic clove, chopped
• 1 tsp ground ginger, cumin, turmeric and cinnamon
• 1/2 cup low-sodium vegetable broth and 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh cilantro
Instructions:
1. Warm the olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat and brown the chicken cubes with onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric and cinnamon for 4 minutes.
2. Add the vegetable broth, carrot, zucchini, olives and lemon juice; cover and simmer for 14-16 minutes.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads 165°F (74°C).
4. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve warm.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Chinese Garlic Chicken & Broccoli Stir-Fry
Ingredients:
• 160g skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced
• 2 cups broccoli florets
• 1/2 cup snap peas
• 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms
• 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp fresh ginger, minced
• 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1/4 cup water
• 1 tsp toasted sesame oil and 1 tsp sesame seeds
Instructions:
1. Stir-fry the sliced chicken in a hot wok or skillet over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes.
2. Add the broccoli, snap peas, mushrooms, garlic, ginger and water; cover and steam-fry for 4 minutes.
3. Stir in the soy sauce and sesame oil and cook until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads 165°F (74°C), then top with sesame seeds.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Tuscan Herbed Chicken with White Beans & Kale
Ingredients:
• 160g skinless chicken breast
• 1/2 cup cooked cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
• 2 cups chopped Tuscan kale
• 1/2 cup diced tomatoes
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tsp dried rosemary, thyme and oregano
• 1/2 cup low-sodium vegetable broth
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Season the chicken breast with rosemary, thyme, oregano and black pepper, and sear in olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes per side.
2. Add the garlic, diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, cannellini beans and kale around the chicken; cover and simmer for 6-8 minutes.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F (74°C) before serving.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Turkish Menemen with Ground Turkey & Herbs
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs, lightly beaten
• 80g lean ground turkey
• 1/2 green bell pepper, diced
• 1 cup diced roma tomatoes
• 1/4 onion, finely chopped
• 1/2 tsp paprika and dried oregano
• 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and brown the ground turkey with onion and green bell pepper for 6 minutes.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Stir in the tomatoes, paprika and oregano and simmer for 3 minutes until juicy.
4. Pour in the beaten eggs, stir gently until the eggs are fully set and firm, and top with fresh parsley.
Safety Notes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Persian Kuku Sabzi (Fresh Herb & Walnut Frittata)
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 1 cup finely chopped fresh parsley, cilantro and dill
• 2 scallions, finely sliced
• 1 cup chopped baby spinach
• 2 tbsp chopped walnuts
• 1/4 tsp ground turmeric
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Whisk the eggs with the turmeric and black pepper, then fold in the chopped herbs, scallions, spinach and walnuts.
2. Warm the olive oil in a small non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and pour in the herb-egg mixture.
3. Cover and cook for 6-7 minutes, then flip and cook for 3 more minutes until firm throughout.

Meal Name: Japanese Chawanmushi-Style Savory Egg & Shiitake Bowl
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 80g firm tofu, cubed
• 1/2 cup sliced shiitake mushrooms
• 1 cup baby spinach
• 3/4 cup low-sodium vegetable broth
• 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce
• 1 scallion, finely chopped
Instructions:
1. Whisk the eggs gently with the vegetable broth and soy sauce until smooth.
2. Arrange the cubed tofu, shiitake mushrooms and baby spinach in a heatproof bowl and pour the egg mixture over them.
3. Place the covered bowl in a steamer basket over simmering water and steam for 12-14 minutes until the egg custard is set in the centre, then garnish with scallion.

Meal Name: Korean Soft Tofu & Egg Morning Stew (Sundubu)
Ingredients:
• 150g soft or silken tofu
• 1 large egg
• 1 cup sliced zucchini and mushrooms
• 1 cup baby spinach
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 3/4 cup low-sodium vegetable broth
• 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
• 1 scallion, sliced
Instructions:
1. Bring the vegetable broth, garlic, soy sauce, zucchini and mushrooms to a simmer in a small pot for 4 minutes.
2. Spoon in the soft tofu in large chunks and add the baby spinach.
3. Crack the egg into the simmering broth, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until the egg is firm, then finish with sesame oil and scallion.

Meal Name: Spanish Spinach, Chickpea & Garlic Egg Skillet
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
• 2 cups fresh spinach
• 2 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
• 1/2 tsp smoked paprika (pimentón)
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and gently toast the sliced garlic for 1 minute.
2. Stir in the smoked paprika and chickpeas and cook for 3 minutes until crisp at the edges.
3. Toss in the fresh spinach until wilted, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until firm.

Meal Name: Mexican Machaca-Style Shredded Chicken & Egg Scramble
Ingredients:
• 100g skinless chicken breast, finely shredded
• 2 large eggs, beaten
• 1/4 green bell pepper and 1/4 onion, diced
• 1 roma tomato, diced
• 1/4 avocado, sliced
• 2 tbsp fresh cilantro
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the avocado oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the shredded chicken with onion and bell pepper for 6-7 minutes.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the chicken reaches at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Add the diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes, then pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until firm.
4. Serve topped with sliced avocado and fresh cilantro.
Safety Notes: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Indian Masala Egg Bhurji with Spinach
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs, beaten
• 2 cups chopped baby spinach
• 1/4 red onion, finely chopped
• 1 roma tomato, finely diced
• 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
• 1/2 tsp ground cumin, turmeric and coriander
• 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Warm the avocado oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the red onion and ginger for 3 minutes.
2. Add the cumin, turmeric, coriander and diced tomato; cook for 3 minutes until softened.
3. Stir in the baby spinach until wilted, pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until fully cooked and firm, then garnish with cilantro.

Meal Name: Indian Spiced Tofu Bhurji & Bell Pepper Scramble
Ingredients:
• 150g firm tofu, crumbled
• 1/2 cup green peas or shelled edamame
• 1/2 bell pepper, finely diced
• 1 cup chopped spinach
• 1 tsp grated ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1/2 tsp ground turmeric, cumin and garam masala
• 1 tsp avocado oil and fresh cilantro
Instructions:
1. Heat the avocado oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the ginger, garlic and bell pepper for 3 minutes.
2. Stir in the turmeric, cumin, garam masala, crumbled tofu and green peas; cook for 5 minutes.
3. Fold in the chopped spinach for 2 minutes until wilted and top with fresh cilantro.

Meal Name: Lebanese Ful Medames (Warm Fava & Chickpea Bowl)
Ingredients:
• 3/4 cup cooked fava beans and chickpeas, rinsed
• 1 hard-boiled egg, halved
• 1/2 cup diced cucumber and tomato
• 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1/2 tsp ground cumin
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Warm the fava beans and chickpeas with garlic, cumin and 2 tbsp water in a small pot for 5 minutes, lightly mashing half the beans.
2. Transfer to a bowl and top with the diced cucumber, tomato, parsley and hard-boiled egg halves.
3. Drizzle with lemon juice and extra-virgin olive oil.

Meal Name: Ethiopian Spiced Red Lentil & Collard Green Hash
Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup cooked red lentils
• 2 cups finely chopped collard greens or kale
• 1 large egg
• 1/4 red onion and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1/2 tsp berbere spice or smoked paprika and cumin
• 1 tsp olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the onion, garlic and collard greens with a splash of water for 5 minutes until tender.
2. Stir in the berbere spice and cooked red lentils and warm through for 3 minutes.
3. Make a well in the centre, crack in the egg, cover and cook for 4-5 minutes until firm.

Meal Name: French Herbes de Provence Mushroom & Spinach Omelet
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs and 2 egg whites
• 1 cup sliced cremini mushrooms
• 1.5 cups baby spinach
• 1/2 tsp herbes de Provence (thyme, rosemary, marjoram)
• 1 tbsp chopped chives
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat half the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat and sauté the mushrooms and spinach with herbes de Provence for 4 minutes; transfer to a plate.
2. Whisk the eggs, egg whites and chives together, warm the remaining oil in the skillet and pour in the eggs.
3. Cook until set, spoon the mushroom-spinach filling onto one half, fold over and cook for 1 more minute until firm.

Meal Name: British Kipper-Style Baked Trout & Tomato Plate
Ingredients:
• 1 rainbow trout fillet (about 150g)
• 2 roma tomatoes, halved
• 1 cup sliced mushrooms
• 1.5 cups baby spinach
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and chopped parsley
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Brush the trout fillet, tomato halves and mushrooms with olive oil and black pepper.
2. Pan-sear or broil for 4-5 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the trout reads 145°F (63°C).
3. Wilt the baby spinach in the warm pan for 1 minute and serve alongside the trout, tomatoes and mushrooms with lemon juice.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: American Southwest Turkey, Black Bean & Avocado Bowl
Ingredients:
• 120g lean ground turkey
• 1/3 cup cooked black beans, rinsed
• 1 cup chopped kale
• 1/2 cup diced tomatoes and bell pepper
• 1/4 avocado, diced
• 1/2 tsp ground cumin and chili powder
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Brown the ground turkey with cumin and chili powder in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Add the kale, black beans, tomatoes and bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes until the kale is tender.
4. Transfer to a bowl and top with diced avocado.
Safety Notes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Brazilian Sardine, Egg & Tomato Savory Skillet
Ingredients:
• 1 can sardines in water or olive oil (about 120g), drained
• 2 large eggs
• 1 cup chopped collard greens or spinach
• 1/2 cup diced tomato and onion
• 2 tbsp chopped cilantro
• 1 tbsp lime juice and 1 tsp olive oil
Instructions:
1. Sauté the onion, tomato and collard greens in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes.
2. Flake in the drained canned sardines and warm through for 2 minutes.
3. Crack in the eggs, scramble gently until the eggs are firm, and finish with lime juice and fresh cilantro.

Meal Name: Peruvian Quinoa, Black Bean & Egg Breakfast Bowl
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 1/3 cup cooked quinoa
• 1/3 cup cooked black beans, rinsed
• 1 cup baby spinach
• 1/4 avocado, sliced
• 1 tbsp lime juice and fresh cilantro
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Warm the quinoa, black beans and baby spinach in a skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes until the spinach wilts.
2. In the same skillet, heat the olive oil and cook the eggs until the whites and yolks are firm.
3. Assemble in a bowl and top with sliced avocado, lime juice and cilantro.

Meal Name: Vietnamese Lemongrass Chicken & Greens Morning Soup
Ingredients:
• 140g skinless chicken breast, thinly sliced
• 2 cups bok choy and bean sprouts
• 1.5 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth
• 1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 stalk bruised lemongrass (or 1 tsp lime zest)
• 2 tbsp fresh cilantro, mint and Thai basil
• 1 lime wedge
Instructions:
1. Bring the broth, ginger and lemongrass to a simmer in a saucepan for 5 minutes.
2. Add the sliced chicken breast and simmer for 6-7 minutes until a food thermometer in the chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Add the bok choy and bean sprouts for 2 minutes until tender-crisp, then ladle into a bowl with fresh herbs and lime.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Thai Ginger-Garlic Chicken & Bok Choy Rice-Free Congee
Ingredients:
• 140g lean ground chicken
• 1.5 cups riced cauliflower
• 1 cup chopped baby bok choy
• 1 cup low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth
• 1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 scallion, sliced, and fresh cilantro
• 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
Instructions:
1. Simmer the riced cauliflower, ginger, garlic and broth in a pot over medium heat for 6 minutes.
2. Stir in the ground chicken, breaking it up fine, and simmer for 6-7 minutes until a food thermometer reads at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Fold in the chopped bok choy for 2 minutes until tender, then top with sesame oil, scallion and cilantro.
Safety Notes: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Greek Yogurt, Hemp Seed, Walnut & Blueberry Bowl
Ingredients:
• 3/4 cup plain unsweetened Greek yogurt
• 1/2 cup fresh blueberries
• 2 tbsp hemp hearts
• 2 tbsp chopped walnuts
• 1 tbsp ground flaxseed
• 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon
Instructions:
1. Spoon the plain Greek yogurt into a chilled bowl.
2. Top evenly with the fresh blueberries, hemp hearts, chopped walnuts and ground flaxseed.
3. Dust with ground cinnamon and serve immediately.

Meal Name: Moroccan Spiced Lentil & Poached Egg Bowl
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 1/2 cup cooked brown or green lentils
• 2 cups baby spinach
• 1/2 cup diced tomatoes
• 1/2 tsp ground cumin, coriander and cinnamon
• 2 tbsp fresh cilantro
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the diced tomatoes, cumin, coriander and cinnamon for 3 minutes.
2. Stir in the cooked lentils and baby spinach until wilted.
3. Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes until firm, then top with cilantro.

Meal Name: Italian Zucchini, Tomato & Basil Frittata
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs and 2 egg whites
• 1 small zucchini, thinly sliced
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 1 cup baby arugula
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 2 tbsp fresh basil leaves, torn
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe or covered skillet over medium heat and sauté the zucchini and garlic for 4 minutes.
2. Add the cherry tomatoes and arugula for 1 minute, then pour in the beaten eggs and egg whites.
3. Cover and cook on medium-low heat for 6-7 minutes until completely set in the centre, then top with fresh basil.

Meal Name: West African Black-Eyed Pea & Spinach Scramble
Ingredients:
• 2 large eggs
• 1/2 cup cooked black-eyed peas, rinsed
• 2 cups chopped spinach
• 1/2 roma tomato and 1/4 red onion, diced
• 1/2 tsp grated fresh ginger and smoked paprika
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the avocado oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté the red onion, tomato and ginger for 3 minutes.
2. Add the black-eyed peas, smoked paprika and spinach; cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
3. Push the greens to one side, scramble the eggs until firm, then toss together and serve.

Meal Name: Scandinavian Dill Cod & Poached Egg over Greens
Ingredients:
• 1 cod fillet (about 140g)
• 1 large egg
• 2 cups steamed asparagus spears and baby spinach
• 1 tbsp chopped fresh dill
• 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Season the cod fillet with dill, lemon juice and black pepper, and pan-sear in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes per side.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the cod reads at least 145°F (63°C).
3. Cook the egg until the white and yolk are firm, and serve over the steamed asparagus and spinach alongside the cod.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Thai Larb Gai (Herbed Minced Chicken Lettuce Cups)
Ingredients:
• 160g lean ground chicken
• 6 crisp butter lettuce leaves
• 1/2 cucumber, thinly sliced
• 1 shallot or 2 scallions, thinly sliced
• 1/2 cup fresh mint, cilantro and Thai basil
• 1.5 tbsp fresh lime juice and 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce
• 1 tbsp crushed unsalted roasted peanuts
Instructions:
1. Cook the ground chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat with 2 tbsp water for 6-7 minutes, breaking it up fine.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the ground chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Toss the warm chicken off the heat with the lime juice, soy sauce, shallot and fresh herbs.
4. Spoon into crisp butter lettuce leaves with cucumber slices and top with crushed peanuts.
Safety Notes: Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Korean Tofu & Mushroom Cauliflower Bibimbap Bowl
Ingredients:
• 140g extra-firm tofu, cubed
• 1 large egg
• 1.5 cups riced cauliflower
• 1 cup baby spinach and 1/2 cup bean sprouts
• 1/2 cup sliced shiitake mushrooms and 1/2 julienned carrot
• 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tsp toasted sesame oil and 1 tsp sesame seeds
Instructions:
1. Pan-sear the tofu cubes in half the sesame oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until golden.
2. Sauté the riced cauliflower, mushrooms, carrot, bean sprouts and spinach with garlic and soy sauce for 4-5 minutes.
3. Fry the egg in the remaining oil until the white and yolk are firm, then arrange over the cauliflower bowl with the tofu and sesame seeds.

Meal Name: Vietnamese Lemongrass Tofu & Cabbage Salad (Goi Ga Style)
Ingredients:
• 150g extra-firm tofu, sliced into strips
• 2.5 cups finely shredded green and purple cabbage
• 1/2 carrot and 1/2 cucumber, julienned
• 1/2 cup fresh mint, cilantro and Thai basil
• 1 tbsp chopped roasted peanuts
• 2 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Sear the tofu strips in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until crisp and golden.
2. Toss the shredded cabbage, carrot, cucumber and fresh herbs with the lime-garlic dressing.
3. Top with the warm crispy tofu and chopped roasted peanuts.

Meal Name: Spanish Garlic Shrimp & White Bean Salad
Ingredients:
• 150g raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
• 1/2 cup cooked white cannellini beans, rinsed
• 2 cups baby spinach and arugula
• 1/2 roasted red bell pepper, sliced
• 2 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
• 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the sliced garlic and smoked paprika for 30 seconds.
2. Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until opaque and cooked through.
3. Toss the spinach, arugula, white beans and roasted red pepper with lemon juice, and top with the warm garlic shrimp.

Meal Name: Italian Tuscan Tuna, Chickpea & Arugula Salad
Ingredients:
• 1 can tuna in water (about 140g), drained
• 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
• 2 cups baby arugula
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 1 celery stalk, finely sliced
• 1 tbsp red wine vinegar or lemon juice
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh basil
Instructions:
1. Combine the baby arugula, chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, sliced celery and torn basil in a bowl.
2. Top with the flaked canned tuna.
3. Drizzle with the lemon juice and extra-virgin olive oil, season with black pepper and toss to coat.

Meal Name: Mexican Grilled Fish & Jicama Cabbage Slaw Bowl
Ingredients:
• 160g mahi-mahi or cod fillet
• 2 cups shredded cabbage and julienned jicama (or radish)
• 1/3 cup cooked pinto or black beans, rinsed
• 1/4 avocado, diced
• 2 tbsp plain unsweetened Greek yogurt whisked with 1 tbsp lime juice
• 1/2 tsp chili powder and ground cumin
• 1 tsp avocado oil and fresh cilantro
Instructions:
1. Rub the fish fillet with chili powder, cumin and black pepper, and sear in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
3. Toss the shredded cabbage, jicama and cilantro with the lime-yogurt dressing, and top with the black beans, flaked fish and avocado.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Peruvian Lime-Poached Halibut & Avocado Bowl
Ingredients:
• 160g halibut or cod fillet, cubed
• 1/3 cup cubed sweet potato, steamed
• 2 cups crisp romaine lettuce
• 1/4 red onion, thinly sliced
• 1/4 avocado, sliced
• 2 tbsp fresh lime juice and 1/4 cup vegetable broth
• 2 tbsp fresh cilantro
Instructions:
1. Simmer the fish cubes gently in the vegetable broth and half the lime juice in a covered skillet for 5-6 minutes.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
3. Arrange the romaine lettuce, steamed sweet potato, red onion and avocado in a bowl, top with the fish and drizzle with remaining lime juice and cilantro.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Brazilian Collard Greens, Black Bean & Grilled Chicken Bowl
Ingredients:
• 150g skinless chicken breast
• 1/2 cup cooked black beans, rinsed
• 2 cups finely ribboned collard greens (couve)
• 1/2 cup diced tomato, onion and vinegar salsa (vinagrete)
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1/2 tsp ground cumin
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Season the chicken breast with half the garlic, cumin and black pepper, and grill or sear for 6-7 minutes per side.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Sauté the ribboned collard greens with the remaining garlic in olive oil for 3 minutes until bright green and tender.
4. Serve the sliced chicken over the collard greens and warm black beans, topped with the fresh tomato vinagrete.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Indian Dal Palak (Spiced Red Lentil & Spinach Soup)
Ingredients:
• 1/2 cup dry red lentils, rinsed
• 2.5 cups fresh baby spinach
• 1 roma tomato and 1/4 onion, diced
• 1 tsp grated fresh ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1/2 tsp ground turmeric, cumin seeds and garam masala
• 1.5 cups water or low-sodium vegetable broth
• 1 tsp avocado oil and 1 tbsp lemon juice
Instructions:
1. Simmer the rinsed red lentils with turmeric and broth in a saucepan for 14-15 minutes until soft.
2. In a small skillet, warm the avocado oil and sauté the cumin seeds, onion, garlic, ginger and tomato with garam masala for 4 minutes.
3. Stir the spiced tomato mixture and baby spinach into the lentils, simmer for 2 minutes until wilted, and finish with lemon juice.

Meal Name: Indian Spiced Chickpea, Cucumber & Mint Chana Salad
Ingredients:
• 3/4 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed and drained
• 2 tbsp plain unsweetened Greek yogurt or tahini
• 1 cup diced cucumber and roma tomato
• 1/4 red onion, finely diced
• 1 cup baby spinach
• 1/2 tsp roasted ground cumin and chaat masala (or black pepper)
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 2 tbsp fresh cilantro and mint
Instructions:
1. Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, red onion, spinach, cilantro and mint in a bowl.
2. Whisk the lemon juice, roasted cumin and Greek yogurt (or tahini) together.
3. Toss the salad with the spiced dressing and serve chilled or at room temperature.

Meal Name: Turkish Grilled Chicken Skewers (Tavuk Sis) & Shepherd Salad
Ingredients:
• 160g skinless chicken breast, cubed
• 1 tbsp plain unsweetened Greek yogurt
• 1 cup diced cucumber, tomato and green bell pepper
• 1/4 red onion, thinly sliced
• 2 tbsp chopped flat-leaf parsley
• 1 tsp paprika, oregano and garlic
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Toss the chicken cubes with Greek yogurt, paprika, oregano and garlic.
2. Grill or sear in a hot skillet for 7-8 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest cube reads at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Toss the cucumber, tomato, bell pepper, red onion and parsley with lemon juice and olive oil, and serve alongside the chicken.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Persian Herb, Lentil & Chicken Soup (Ash-e Jo Twist)
Ingredients:
• 140g skinless chicken breast, diced
• 1/3 cup cooked green lentils
• 2 cups chopped spinach, parsley, cilantro and dill
• 1/4 onion and 1 garlic clove, chopped
• 1/2 tsp ground turmeric and cumin
• 1.5 cups low-sodium vegetable broth
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp olive oil
Instructions:
1. Sauté the onion, garlic, turmeric and cumin in olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat for 3 minutes.
2. Add the diced chicken breast, cooked lentils and broth; cover and simmer for 12-14 minutes.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the chicken reaches at least 165°F (74°C).
4. Stir in the chopped spinach and fresh herbs for 3 minutes until tender, and finish with lemon juice.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Ethiopian Chicken Tibs with Garlic Collard Greens (Gomen)
Ingredients:
• 160g skinless chicken breast, cubed
• 2.5 cups chopped collard greens
• 1/4 red onion, sliced
• 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp fresh ginger, minced
• 1 tsp berbere spice or paprika, cumin and cardamom
• 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Steam or braise the collard greens with half the garlic and 1/4 cup water in a covered pan for 8 minutes until tender.
2. In a skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and sear the chicken cubes with red onion, remaining garlic, ginger and berbere spice for 7-8 minutes.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C), squeeze lemon juice over top, and serve with the collard greens.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Moroccan Spiced Carrot, Chickpea & Grilled Turkey Salad
Ingredients:
• 150g turkey breast cutlet
• 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas, rinsed
• 2 cups baby spinach and arugula
• 1 medium carrot, julienned
• 1 tbsp toasted pumpkin seeds
• 1/2 tsp ground cumin, cinnamon and paprika
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Rub the turkey breast cutlet with cumin, cinnamon, paprika and black pepper, and pan-sear in olive oil for 5-6 minutes per side.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Toss the spinach, arugula, carrot and chickpeas with lemon juice, top with sliced turkey and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds.
Safety Notes: Cook turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: French Salad Niçoise with Seared Salmon & Green Beans
Ingredients:
• 140g salmon fillet
• 1 hard-boiled egg, halved
• 1 cup fresh green beans, steamed tender-crisp
• 2 cups mixed salad greens
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 6 Niçoise or kalamata olives
• 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Sear the salmon fillet in a non-stick skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part reads at least 145°F (63°C).
2. Arrange the salad greens, steamed green beans, cherry tomatoes, olives and hard-boiled egg on a plate.
3. Top with the warm salmon fillet and drizzle with the whisked Dijon, lemon juice and olive oil dressing.
Safety Notes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Nordic Open-Faced Sardine, Egg & Cucumber Rye Plate
Ingredients:
• 1 can sardines in water or olive oil (about 120g), drained
• 1 hard-boiled egg, sliced
• 1 thin slice 100% whole-grain sprouted rye bread, toasted
• 1 cup sliced cucumber and radishes
• 1 cup baby arugula
• 1 tbsp fresh dill and 1 tbsp lemon juice
Instructions:
1. Layer the baby arugula, cucumber slices, drained canned sardines and sliced hard-boiled egg over the toasted rye slice and alongside on the plate.
2. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the sardines and garnish generously with fresh dill and radish slices.

Meal Name: American California Turkey, Avocado & Greens Cobb Bowl
Ingredients:
• 150g turkey breast cutlet
• 1 hard-boiled egg, quartered
• 2.5 cups chopped romaine and watercress
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes and 1/2 cucumber, diced
• 1/4 avocado, diced
• 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
• 1 tsp Dijon mustard
Instructions:
1. Season the turkey breast with black pepper and garlic powder, and grill or pan-sear for 5-6 minutes per side.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C), then slice.
3. Arrange the romaine, watercress, tomatoes, cucumber, avocado, hard-boiled egg and turkey in a bowl, and drizzle with whisked vinegar, Dijon and olive oil.
Safety Notes: Cook turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Chinese Sesame-Ginger Tofu & Cabbage Slaw
Ingredients:
• 150g extra-firm tofu, cubed
• 1/3 cup shelled edamame, steamed
• 2.5 cups shredded Napa cabbage and purple cabbage
• 1/2 carrot, julienned, and 2 scallions, sliced
• 1 tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce
• 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
• 1 tsp toasted sesame oil and 1 tbsp sliced almonds
Instructions:
1. Sear the cubed tofu in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until golden on all sides.
2. Whisk together the rice vinegar, soy sauce, grated ginger and toasted sesame oil.
3. Toss the shredded cabbage, carrot, scallions and edamame with the dressing, and top with the warm tofu and sliced almonds.

Meal Name: Greek Grilled Halibut & Artichoke Salad
Ingredients:
• 160g halibut or snapper fillet
• 1/2 cup marinated artichoke hearts (in water), quartered
• 2 cups chopped romaine and baby spinach
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes and cucumber, diced
• 1 tsp dried oregano and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Season the fish fillet with oregano, garlic, half the lemon juice and olive oil.
2. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat for 4 minutes per side until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
3. Arrange the romaine, spinach, artichoke hearts, tomatoes and cucumber on a plate, top with the fish and drizzle with remaining lemon juice.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Nordic Dill-Baked Salmon with Roasted Brussels Sprouts
Ingredients:
• 160g salmon fillet
• 1.5 cups Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
• 1/2 cup asparagus spears
• 1 tbsp chopped fresh dill
• 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1.5 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the halved Brussels sprouts and asparagus with 1 tsp olive oil and roast on a sheet pan for 10 minutes.
2. Place the salmon fillet on the sheet pan, rub with the remaining olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and fresh dill.
3. Roast for 12-14 minutes more until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the salmon reads at least 145°F (63°C).
Safety Notes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Greek Lemon-Garlic Haddock with Braised Greens (Horta)
Ingredients:
• 170g haddock or cod fillet
• 3 cups chopped dandelion greens, Swiss chard or spinach
• 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1.5 tbsp fresh lemon juice
• 1.5 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Sauté half the garlic in 1 tsp olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat, add the chopped greens and a splash of water, and braise for 5 minutes until tender.
2. Season the haddock fillet with oregano, remaining garlic and lemon juice, and sear in a pan for 4 minutes per side.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the fish reads at least 145°F (63°C), then serve over the braised lemon greens.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Spanish Pollo al Ajillo (Garlic-Herb Chicken) with Zucchini
Ingredients:
• 170g skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
• 1.5 cups sliced zucchini and roasted red bell peppers
• 1 cup baby spinach
• 4 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
• 1 bay leaf and 1/2 tsp fresh thyme
• 1/3 cup low-sodium vegetable broth and 1 tbsp lemon juice
• 1.5 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and chopped parsley
Instructions:
1. Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the sliced garlic for 2 minutes until lightly golden.
2. Add the chicken pieces, bay leaf and thyme; sear for 6-7 minutes until browned.
3. Add the zucchini, red peppers, broth and lemon juice; simmer for 5-6 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
4. Fold in the spinach and parsley and serve.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Italian Chicken Cacciatore with Mushrooms & Bell Peppers
Ingredients:
• 170g skinless chicken breast
• 1 cup sliced cremini mushrooms
• 1/2 bell pepper and 1/4 onion, sliced
• 3/4 cup crushed tomatoes (no sugar added)
• 1 tsp capers and 4 kalamata olives
• 2 garlic cloves, minced, and 1 tsp Italian herbs
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh basil
Instructions:
1. Sear the chicken breast in olive oil over medium heat for 4 minutes per side.
2. Add the onion, bell pepper, mushrooms and garlic around the chicken and cook for 4 minutes.
3. Pour in the crushed tomatoes, Italian herbs, capers and olives; cover and simmer for 10-12 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
4. Garnish with fresh basil and serve.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Turkish Baked Eggplants with Spiced Ground Turkey
Ingredients:
• 1 small eggplant, halved lengthwise
• 150g lean ground turkey
• 1/2 cup diced tomatoes
• 1/4 onion and 1/2 green pepper, finely diced
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1/2 tsp ground cumin, paprika and cinnamon
• 2 tbsp chopped flat-leaf parsley
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Score the eggplant halves, brush with half the olive oil and roast for 18 minutes until tender.
2. Meanwhile, brown the ground turkey with onion, green pepper, garlic, cumin, paprika and cinnamon in a skillet for 7 minutes, then stir in the tomatoes.
3. Spoon the turkey filling over the eggplant halves and bake for 8 minutes until a food thermometer in the centre of the turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
4. Top with fresh parsley and serve.
Safety Notes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Persian Ghormeh Sabzi (Fresh Herb, Kidney Bean & Chicken Stew)
Ingredients:
• 160g skinless chicken breast, cubed
• 1/2 cup cooked red kidney beans, rinsed
• 2.5 cups finely chopped parsley, cilantro, spinach and scallions
• 1/4 onion and 2 garlic cloves, chopped
• 1/2 tsp ground turmeric and fenugreek leaves
• 1 cup low-sodium vegetable broth and 1.5 tbsp fresh lime juice
• 1.5 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Sauté the finely chopped herbs and spinach in 1 tsp olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until dark green and fragrant.
2. In a pot, brown the chicken cubes with onion, garlic and turmeric in the remaining oil for 5 minutes.
3. Add the sautéed herbs, kidney beans, broth and lime juice; cover and simmer for 18-20 minutes.
4. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C) before serving.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Lebanese Baked Kibbeh-Spiced Turkey & Cucumber Salad
Ingredients:
• 160g lean ground turkey
• 2 tbsp fine bulgur wheat or ground flaxseed, soaked in water
• 1/4 onion, grated, and 2 tbsp chopped fresh mint and parsley
• 1/2 tsp ground allspice, cinnamon and cumin
• 1.5 cups diced cucumber, tomato and radish salad
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Mix the ground turkey, soaked bulgur (or flaxseed), grated onion, mint, allspice, cinnamon and cumin.
2. Press into a small baking dish, score into diamonds, brush with olive oil and bake for 20-22 minutes.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the centre of the turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
4. Serve alongside the crisp cucumber, tomato and radish salad dressed with lemon juice.
Safety Notes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Ethiopian Doro Wat Style Spiced Chicken & Red Lentils
Ingredients:
• 160g skinless chicken breast or thigh, cubed
• 1 hard-boiled egg
• 1/3 cup cooked red lentils
• 1.5 cups steamed collard greens
• 1/2 red onion, finely diced
• 1 tsp grated ginger and 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1.5 tsp berbere spice blend
• 1 tsp avocado oil and 3/4 cup vegetable broth
Instructions:
1. Cook the finely diced red onion in avocado oil with a splash of water over medium-low heat for 6 minutes until soft.
2. Stir in the garlic, ginger and berbere spice for 1 minute, then add the chicken and vegetable broth.
3. Cover and simmer for 16-18 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
4. Nestle the hard-boiled egg into the sauce and serve alongside the red lentils and steamed collard greens.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Moroccan Spiced Turkey & Chickpea Harira Stew
Ingredients:
• 150g lean ground turkey
• 1/2 cup cooked chickpeas and 1/4 cup cooked green lentils
• 1 cup crushed tomatoes and 1 cup vegetable broth
• 1 celery stalk and 1/4 onion, diced
• 1 tsp grated ginger, turmeric, cumin and cinnamon
• 1/3 cup chopped fresh cilantro and parsley
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp olive oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat and brown the ground turkey with onion, celery and ginger for 6-7 minutes.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reaches at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Add the turmeric, cumin, cinnamon, crushed tomatoes, broth, chickpeas and lentils; simmer for 12-15 minutes.
4. Stir in the fresh cilantro, parsley and lemon juice before serving.
Safety Notes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: West African Ginger-Peanut Chicken & Kale Stew
Ingredients:
• 160g skinless chicken breast, cubed
• 2 cups chopped kale or collard greens
• 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes and 3/4 cup vegetable broth
• 1 tbsp natural unsweetened peanut butter
• 1/4 onion, 1 garlic clove and 1 tsp fresh ginger, minced
• 1/4 tsp cayenne or black pepper
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Sear the chicken cubes with onion, garlic and ginger in avocado oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
2. Whisk in the crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth and natural peanut butter, then cover and simmer for 14-16 minutes.
3. Stir in the chopped kale for the last 4 minutes of cooking.
4. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C) before serving.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Indian Tandoori Salmon with Roasted Cauliflower & Spinach
Ingredients:
• 160g salmon fillet
• 1.5 cups cauliflower florets
• 1.5 cups baby spinach
• 1.5 tbsp plain unsweetened Greek yogurt
• 1 tsp garam masala, ground cumin, coriander and turmeric
• 1 tsp grated ginger and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the cauliflower florets with avocado oil and a pinch of turmeric and roast on a sheet pan for 10 minutes.
2. Coat the salmon fillet with Greek yogurt, ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin and coriander, and place on the sheet pan.
3. Roast for 12-14 minutes more until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the salmon reads at least 145°F (63°C).
4. Serve over fresh baby spinach with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Safety Notes: Cook salmon to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Indian Chicken Tikka Skillet with Peppers & Fenugreek Greens
Ingredients:
• 170g skinless chicken breast, cubed
• 2 tbsp plain unsweetened Greek yogurt
• 1/2 bell pepper and 1/4 red onion, cut into petals
• 2 cups chopped spinach
• 1/2 cup tomato purée
• 1 tsp garam masala, cumin, paprika and dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi)
• 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 garlic clove and 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Marinate the chicken cubes in Greek yogurt, ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin and paprika.
2. Sear the chicken, bell pepper and onion in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
3. Add the tomato purée, fenugreek leaves and spinach; simmer for 6-8 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Japanese Miso-Glazed Cod with Baby Bok Choy & Edamame
Ingredients:
• 170g cod or halibut fillet
• 1.5 cups baby bok choy, halved
• 1/2 cup shelled edamame, steamed
• 1 tbsp white miso paste
• 1 tsp rice vinegar and 1 tbsp water
• 1 tsp grated fresh ginger
• 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
Instructions:
1. Whisk together the white miso paste, rice vinegar, grated ginger, sesame oil and water.
2. Brush the cod fillet with the miso glaze and bake at 400°F (200°C) or pan-sear over medium heat for 10-12 minutes.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the cod reads at least 145°F (63°C).
4. Steam the baby bok choy and edamame for 4 minutes and serve alongside the miso-glazed cod.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Thai Lemongrass Poached Snapper with Bok Choy & Mushrooms
Ingredients:
• 170g red snapper or mahi-mahi fillet
• 1.5 cups baby bok choy and 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms
• 1 cup low-sodium vegetable broth
• 1 stalk bruised lemongrass and 1 tsp grated ginger
• 1 garlic clove, sliced
• 1 tbsp fresh lime juice and 1 tsp low-sodium soy sauce
• 2 tbsp fresh cilantro and Thai basil
Instructions:
1. Bring the vegetable broth, lemongrass, ginger, garlic and mushrooms to a gentle simmer in a deep skillet for 5 minutes.
2. Nestle the snapper fillet and baby bok choy into the fragrant broth, cover and poach for 7-9 minutes.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
4. Stir in the lime juice and soy sauce, and garnish with fresh cilantro and Thai basil.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: Vietnamese Ginger-Scallion Chicken with Chayote & Greens
Ingredients:
• 170g skinless chicken breast, sliced
• 1 medium chayote squash (or zucchini), julienned
• 1.5 cups Chinese broccoli or baby spinach
• 2 scallions, cut into 1-inch pieces
• 1 tbsp finely julienned fresh ginger and 2 garlic cloves
• 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce and 1/4 cup water
• 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and stir-fry the ginger, garlic and chicken slices for 5 minutes.
2. Add the chayote squash, Chinese broccoli, soy sauce and water; cover and cook for 5-6 minutes.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest slice of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C), toss with the scallions and serve.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Mexican Smoky Turkey, Black Bean & Zucchini Enchilada Skillet
Ingredients:
• 160g lean ground turkey
• 1/3 cup cooked black beans, rinsed
• 1 medium zucchini, cubed
• 1/2 cup fire-roasted crushed tomatoes
• 1/4 onion and 1 garlic clove, minced
• 1 tsp chili powder, ground cumin and oregano
• 1/4 avocado, sliced, and 2 tbsp fresh cilantro
• 1 tsp avocado oil
Instructions:
1. Heat the avocado oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and brown the ground turkey with onion, garlic, chili powder, cumin and oregano for 6-7 minutes.
2. Check with a food thermometer that the ground turkey reads at least 165°F (74°C).
3. Stir in the cubed zucchini, black beans and fire-roasted tomatoes; cover and simmer for 6-8 minutes until the zucchini is tender.
4. Top with sliced avocado and fresh cilantro.
Safety Notes: Cook ground turkey to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Peruvian Aji-Style Herb Chicken with Cauliflower & Olives
Ingredients:
• 170g skinless chicken breast, sliced
• 1.5 cups cauliflower florets, steamed
• 1 cup baby spinach
• 2 tbsp walnut pieces, toasted
• 1/4 onion, 2 garlic cloves and 1/2 yellow bell pepper, blended with 1/4 cup vegetable broth
• 4 kalamata olives, halved
• 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh cilantro
Instructions:
1. Sear the chicken slices in olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
2. Pour in the blended yellow pepper, onion, garlic, walnut and vegetable broth sauce; simmer for 8-10 minutes until thickened.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest piece of chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
4. Serve over the steamed cauliflower and baby spinach, garnished with olives and cilantro.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

Meal Name: Brazilian Moqueca-Style Fish & Bell Pepper Stew (Olive Oil)
Ingredients:
• 170g firm white fish fillet (cod, mahi-mahi or snapper), cut into chunks
• 1/2 red and 1/2 yellow bell pepper, sliced
• 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes and 1/2 cup vegetable broth
• 1/4 onion and 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1/2 tsp sweet paprika and ground cumin
• 1.5 tbsp fresh lime juice and 1/3 cup chopped cilantro
• 1.5 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
Instructions:
1. Marinate the fish chunks with half the lime juice and garlic for 5 minutes.
2. In a deep skillet, sauté the onion, bell peppers, remaining garlic, paprika and cumin in olive oil for 4 minutes, then add the crushed tomatoes and broth.
3. Nestle the fish chunks into the simmering sauce, cover and cook for 7-8 minutes until a food thermometer in the thickest piece of fish reads at least 145°F (63°C).
4. Finish with remaining lime juice and fresh cilantro.
Safety Notes: Cook fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).

Meal Name: French Provençal Roast Chicken with Ratatouille Vegetables
Ingredients:
• 170g skinless chicken breast
• 1 cup cubed eggplant and zucchini
• 1/2 bell pepper, diced
• 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tsp herbes de Provence (thyme, rosemary, oregano)
• 1.5 tsp extra-virgin olive oil and fresh basil
Instructions:
1. Season the chicken breast with half the herbes de Provence and black pepper, and sear in olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat for 4 minutes per side.
2. Add the eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, garlic, crushed tomatoes and remaining herbs around the chicken, then cover and simmer for 12-14 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
3. Check with a food thermometer that the thickest part of the chicken reads at least 165°F (74°C).
4. Garnish with fresh basil and serve.
Safety Notes: Cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
